skipped.name: Characters, settings, and events
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Listening to Texts Read Aloud' (flagaloud), which already covers who, where, what goes wrong and retelling in order.

skipped.name: The Kekulé model of benzene
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'The puzzle of benzene's structure' (flagbenz), which already builds the Kekulé structure and tests it against bromine water, hydrogenation enthalpy and bond lengths.

skipped.name: Justifying Views About Texts
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Using and Evaluating Textual Evidence' (flagevid), which already teaches backing a view about a text with the line that proves it and rating evidence; same family as the skipped 'Literary Evidence in Writing'.

skipped.name: Choosing Formal Vocabulary
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Formal and informal English' (flagreg), whose 'Make it formal' step already swaps informal words for formal ones (can→may, grab→borrow, Hi→Dear) and judges register for audience.

skipped.name: Mild to Strong Emotions
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Emotion Vocabulary' (flagemo), whose thermometer step already ranks feeling words from mild to strong (annoyed, cross, furious) and matches them to situations.

skipped.name: Growth Mindset
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'flagtry' and 'flagbounce', whose labs already teach the power of 'yet', mistakes as clues, and growth versus fixed mindset statements.

skipped.name: Positive Self-Talk
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'flagtry' and 'flagbounce', which already teach catching unhelpful thoughts and flipping them into helpful, true ones (the power of 'yet', past a 'just be positive' trap); lesson 187 defines self-talk.

skipped.name: Antonyms & Synonyms
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Shades of Meaning' (flagshade), which already ranks synonyms by strength and picks the most precise word for a sentence, and 'Sorting & Categorising Words' (flagsortw), whose 'Opposites' step pairs antonyms.

skipped.name: Expressing Feelings with Words
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Triggers and Causes of Feelings' (flagcause, builds 'I feel … when …' sentences), the I-statement builder in flagassert, and flagmood/flagbig, which already teach saying the feeling or telling a grown-up instead of hitting or throwing.

skipped.name: Fairness, Equality and Equity
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Vocabulary: social awareness' (flagaware), whose 'Equal or fair?' step already shares boxes behind a fence to contrast equality and equity, with items on giving by need (cushions, ramp).

skipped.name: Using New Vocabulary
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'New words' (flagnewword), whose gap test already has learners use a new word in a sentence, plus 'Shades of Meaning' (flagshade) and flagwonder word work.

skipped.name: Stop, Think, Then Choose
skipped.reason: Overlaps flagcool, which builds the stop-think-choose plan step by step, and flagdecide's choices-and-consequences fork.

skipped.name: Actions and Their Consequences
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Vocabulary: making decisions and keeping safe' (flagdecide), whose fork already follows each choice to its consequence.

skipped.name: Learning from Mistakes
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Persisting When It's Hard' (flagtry, ages 5-6), which already treats misses as clues, uses 'yet' and keep-going thoughts after a mistake, and the growth-mindset flips in flagbounce.

skipped.name: Discussing Texts as a Group
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Building on Others in Discussions', 'Listening and Responding' (flaglisten), 'Exploring Ideas Through Talk' (flagwonder) and 'Engaging Listeners and Valuing Viewpoints', which already cover turn-taking, listening and building on others' ideas about a text.

skipped.name: Group discussions
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Listening and Responding' (flaglisten, ages 4-11, staying on topic and replying across turns), 'Building on Others in Discussions' (flagbuildon, 'I agree because...') and 'Engaging Listeners and Valuing Viewpoints' (flagengage), which already cover staying on topic, multi-turn exchanges and building on another speaker.

skipped.name: Patterns in Your Own Reactions
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Emotional patterns over time' (flagepat), which already has learners log their own reactions, spot repeating triggers and times of day, and plan a response to a recurring pattern.

skipped.name: Naming Your Feelings
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Naming Basic Emotions' (flagfeel: names happy, sad, angry and scared from face and body clues) plus 'Emotion Vocabulary' (flagemo) and 'Words for Big Feelings', which already teach noticing and labelling a feeling.

skipped.name: Grammar words: letter, word, sentence
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Understanding print' (sorts letters from words), 'Starting and Ending Sentences' (capital letter, full stop, question mark, exclamation mark) and 'Regular Plural Nouns' (singular and plural); every term in its Year 1 list is already taught by name.

skipped.name: Other People's Feelings and Thoughts
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Seeing Someone Else's Point of View' (flagpov), which already gives two people different feelings about one dog and asks how the other person sees it, and 'Feelings Change and Differ' (flagmood), which shows why two children feel differently about the same thing.

skipped.name: Writing opinions
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Expressing & Justifying Opinions' (flagopine), which already builds 'I think ... because ...' and picks real, clear reasons for a preference.

skipped.name: Vivid Word Choices
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Shades of Meaning' (flagshade: tiptoe, march, sprint; big, huge, gigantic) and 'Author's word choices' (flagauth: swap a verb, turn a scene spooky), which already teach choosing precise verbs and adjectives for an effect.

skipped.name: Revising and editing (age 8+)
skipped.reason: Overlaps 'Reviewing your own writing' (256) and 'Responding to writing feedback' (270), which already cover rereading as the reader and making changes for clarity and effect.
